conditions: Evaluation reaches the LexicalBinding : BindingIdentifier production of a let LexicalDeclaration.
limitations: This governs declaration evaluation. Reads of a still-uninitialized lexical binding and for-in or for-of binding initialization are separate cases.

triggers: Controlling edition correction, applicability change, or material counterexample.

statement: Evaluation of an ordinary ECMAScript 2024 let binding identifier with no initializer initializes that binding to undefined.
